terminal_conventions.resistor_13: a is the left filtered-B+ end and b is the right shared-screen-feed end. Corrected from the v0.40 grid/B− misinterpretation; no polarity implied.
terminal_conventions.transformer_12: sReturn denotes the lower secondary terminal on the native schematic; winding polarity and electrical parameters are not inferred.

verified_endpoints.interpretation: Lower #12 secondary lead descends, turns right, then down to the distinct lower AVC rail. It crosses the B+ and B− rails without junction dots.
Left #13 lead meets the lower right #10 winding lead and lower #12 primary lead at a dotted junction; that primary lead joins the filtered B+ rail.
Right #13 lead rises to the 7B7 screen branch and the continuous shared 7A8/7B7 screen rail. Its crossing of filtered B+ has no junction dot.
